subject: human body
title: The 5 Elements Your Body Is Made Of, Ranked (#1 Isn't Carbon)

scenes.text: The five elements your body is made of. Number one isn't carbon.
Number five: calcium. About one percent of you, most of it locked in your bones.
scenes.label: Calcium · about 1%

scenes.text: Number four: nitrogen. About three percent, built into every protein and every strand of DNA.
scenes.label: Nitrogen · about 3%

scenes.text: Number three: hydrogen. Only ten percent of your weight, but six in ten of your atoms.
scenes.label: Hydrogen · about 10%

scenes.text: Number two: carbon. About eighteen percent, the backbone of every cell.
scenes.label: Carbon · about 18%

scenes.text: Number one: oxygen. About sixty-five percent of you, because you're mostly water.
scenes.label: Oxygen · about 65%

description:
By weight, you are mostly oxygen: about 65 percent, because most of your body is water.
Carbon is about 18 percent, hydrogen about 10, nitrogen about 3 and calcium about 1. Count atoms instead, and hydrogen wins by far.
Which element surprised you most?
first_comment: Phosphorus would be number six, at under one percent. Which would you have guessed at number one, and what should we rank next?
